about.title: About WBU
about.subtitle: A modern university committed to academic quality, social responsibility, and regional development
about.builtForFuture: A University for the Western Balkans and Beyond
about.overview1: Western Balkan University was established with a clear mission: to provide accessible, high-quality higher education that meets European standards. Located along the Tirana–Durrës highway in Kashar, WBU serves a diverse student body drawn from Albania, Kosovo, North Macedonia, and the wider region.
about.overview2: With modern facilities, dedicated faculty, and a curriculum designed in collaboration with industry and international academic partners, WBU prepares graduates who are ready to lead in their professions and contribute to the development of their communities.
about.missionText: To deliver quality higher education that combines rigorous academic training with practical skills development. WBU is dedicated to advancing knowledge through teaching, research, and community engagement, while fostering an inclusive environment that respects diversity and encourages lifelong learning.
about.visionText: To be recognized as a leading private university in Southeast Europe — distinguished by the quality of our graduates, the impact of our research, and our commitment to ethical leadership and sustainable development across the Western Balkans.
about.academicExcellenceDesc: Maintaining high standards in teaching, assessment, and continuous improvement.
about.inclusivityDesc: Welcoming students of all backgrounds, abilities, and perspectives.
about.globalPerspectiveDesc: Building bridges with universities, institutions, and employers worldwide.
about.integrityDesc: Upholding transparency, fairness, and ethical conduct in all operations.
about.leadershipSub: Meet the team guiding WBU's academic and strategic direction
